newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary March PPI UP 1.5pct m/m, 21.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary March PPI UP 1.5pct m/m, 21.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Hungary's producer price index (PPI) in March was up 1.5 percent in month-on-month terms, compared with 2.1 percent in February, and was up 21.8 percent year-on-year, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
NOTE: The KSH revised its earlier preliminary figure of 22.2 percent for year-on-year PPI change in March 1997.

The KSH added that domestic sales prices in March rose 1.4 percent month-on-month and were up by 23.1 percent in year-on-year terms. Export sales prices, calculated in forints, rose 1.8 percent month-on-month and 19.1 percent year-on-year.
Hungary's consumer price index (CPI) in March was 18.8 percent year-on-year and 1.9 percent month-on-month.
